question: Given a non-partitioned table space TS1 is built with LOCKSIZE ROW, LOCKMAX 1000 and SEGSIZE 64. If a unit of work acquires 1001 locks against table space TS1, the lock will be escalated to which of the following levels? A. PAGE B. TABLE C. PARTITION D. TABLESPACE
discussion: Selected Answer: B Segsize 64 means it's a segmented table space, so Db2 has the option of escalating to table rather than tablespace. Documentation is not clear whether this will ALWAYS be the case. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
It would be B Table lock..from Row and Page it will escalate to Table level for non-part tablespaces upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

Believe escalation is always to TS, even if you have the old TS with many tables in it, hence the recommendation to LOCK TABLE if you anticipate need to use many locks. Can be granular to PARTITION (not the case in this example) Rgds upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
For non-partitioned table it will Table Lock. Answer is B. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: Which privilege will user smith be able to grant to another user on table emp when the following SQL is executed? GRANT ALL ON TABLE emp TO smith WITH GRANT OPTION; A. BIND B. REORG C. TRIGGER D. EXECUTE
discussion: It would be Trigger answer is C..BIND and Execute grants are for Plan and Reorg for Database upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
